title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Seriously Studying, Implementing, and Enforcing the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations

Fa Fa [2010] No. 52

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Law of the People's Republic of China on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations (hereinafter referred to as the "Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations") was adopted at the 17th Session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress on October 28, 2010, and shall come into force on April 1, 2011. The Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations is an important component of the civil law of China, aiming to clarify the application of laws to civil relations involving foreign elements, including marriage and family, inheritance, property rights, obligatory rights, and intellectual property rights, so as to provide a basis for resolving foreign-related civil disputes and safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the parties. To ensure the correct application of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations in future trial work, we hereby notify you of the following issues concerning the study, implementation, and enforcement of the said Law:

1. The Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations is the first separate law of China on the application of laws to foreign-related civil relations. The promulgation of this Law will inevitably have a significant and far-reaching impact on China's foreign-related civil trial work. People's courts at all levels shall actively organize adjudicative personnel to earnestly study the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations, accurately grasp the legislative intent, deeply understand the meaning of each provision, and fully recognize the importance of this Law in regulating China's foreign-related civil relations and its positive role in promoting international civil exchanges.

2. Several laws, including the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, contain specific chapters or provisions that clearly stipulate the application of laws to relevant foreign-related civil relations. Since the implementation of these laws, people's courts at all levels have earnestly implemented and enforced them, adjudicated a large number of foreign-related civil cases in accordance with these laws, and accumulated rich trial experience. After the implementation of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations, people's courts at all levels shall pay attention to the relationship between the new law and the old law in terms of application, and earnestly implement the spirit of Articles 2 and 51 of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations.

3. For disputes arising from foreign-related civil relations that occurred before the implementation of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations, the relevant legal provisions in force at the time of the act shall apply; if there are no relevant legal provisions at the time of the act, the provisions of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations may be referred to.

4. After the implementation of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations, those provisions in judicial interpretations formulated by the Supreme People's Court concerning the application of laws to foreign-related civil relations that conflict with the provisions of the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations shall no longer apply.

5. In the process of implementing and enforcing the Law on the Application of Laws to Foreign-Related Civil Relations, people's courts at all levels shall pay attention to summarizing trial experience, strengthen investigation and research, and earnestly ensure the effective implementation of this Law. For difficult issues encountered during the implementation and enforcement process, please promptly report them to our Court. When reporting, you shall propose solutions or indicative opinions for reference in research or when necessary for formulating judicial interpretations.

December 2, 2010
